injuries.name: Malik Nabers
injuries.headline: Malik Nabers (shoulder) returns to Monday Night Football
injuries.comment: Nabers was initially questionable to return with a shoulder injury that appeared to put him in a lot of pain. However, it seems to be just a stinger, and he’s back on the field. It’s worth keeping an eye on though, as another hit could put him right back out.

injuries.name: Charlie Kolar
injuries.headline: Charlie Kolar (forearm) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Kolar suffered the injury in Sunday's game against the Raiders. With David Njoku also on IR, Oronde Gadsden is the only healthy tight end on the Chargers right now.

injuries.name: David Njoku
injuries.headline: David Njoku (knee) placed on IR
injuries.comment: Njoku was carted off the field in Sunday's game against the Raiders. With Charlie Kolar (forearm) also placed on IR, Oronde Gadsden is the only healthy tight end on the Chargers right now.

injuries.name: Mykel Williams
injuries.headline: Mykel Williams (knee) will not return to practice this week
injuries.comment: Williams opened the season on the PUP list. He is working his way back from a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Demarcus Robinson
injuries.headline: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) could be placed on IR
injuries.comment: Robinson would be forced to miss at least four games if he is placed on IR.

injuries.name: Patrick Jones II
injuries.headline: Patrick Jones II (back) hopeful to return in Week 3
injuries.comment: Jones missed the first two games of the season with a back injury.

injuries.name: Josh Simmons
injuries.headline: Josh Simmons (back) without clear update on return
injuries.comment: Reid said Simmons has been doing 'everything' behind the scenes. The Chiefs want to make sure his swelling is down.

injuries.name: Avonte Maddox
injuries.headline: Avonte Maddox (foot) out for season with foot injury
injuries.comment: It’s a tough break for Maddox and the Detroit defense, who lose yet another veteran in what is already a struggling defense. They’ll have to bring in some new names and hope for the best in their defensive backfield.

injuries.name: Sam Darnold
injuries.headline: Sam Darnold (glute) could return to practice this week
injuries.comment: Macdonald clarified it is too soon to know Darnold's status for Week 3 against the Commanders. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week, but it seems unlikely he returns next week as of now.

injuries.name: Rico Dowdle
injuries.headline: Rico Dowdle (toe) returns to the game Sunday
injuries.comment: Dowdle was carted to the locker room in the second quarter but has returned and took the first carry of the second half. Dowdle and Jaylen Warren will continue to operate as the top two running backs for the Steelers.

injuries.name: Saquon Barkley
injuries.headline: Saquon Barkley (stinger) returns to the game
injuries.comment: Barkley was seen on the sidelines holding his helmet after his first half injury and he did not return prior to halftime. Barkley took a carry in the third quarter and appears poised to return as the primary running back for the remainder of the game.

injuries.name: Eli Raridon
injuries.headline: Eli Raridon (thigh) questionable to return
injuries.comment: It is not immediately clear how Raridon suffered the injury. If the rookie is unable to return, Julian Hill will serve as the backup tight end to Hunter Henry.

injuries.name: A.J. Terrell Jr.
injuries.headline: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) doubtful to return
injuries.comment: Terrell was originally evaluated for a concussion and was cleared, but also suffered a groin injury prior to leaving the game. The Falcons appear to be without their best defender in their secondary for the remainder of Week 2.

injuries.name: Javon Hargrave
injuries.headline: Javon Hargrave (knee, concussion) will not play Sunday
injuries.comment: Hargrave will not be available for Sunday's matchup with the Jets, as he is dealing with multiple issues. Jonathan Ford and Chris McClellan will likely see more snaps on defense.

injuries.name: Carlton Davis III
injuries.headline: Carlton Davis III (neck) won't play Sunday
injuries.comment: Davis did not practice this week due to a neck issue. The veteran corner will take a seat on Sunday, as Charles Woods will likely step into more snaps on defense. Davis will try to be back for Week 3.

injuries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
injuries.headline: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) placed on injured reserve
injuries.comment: The Jets are placing their first-round rookie on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in his NFL debut last week. He is going to miss at least four weeks as a result, but he's not expected to be out much beyond that. Adonai Mitchell and Kenyon Sadiq will both see increased opportunities in his absence for the next few weeks at least.

injuries.name: Kene Nwangwu
injuries.headline: Kene Nwangwu (back) won't play Sunday
injuries.comment: Nwangwu missed New York's season opener last week due to injury, and he is now set to miss another game on Sunday due to a back issue that he's dealing with. His absence won't have much of an impact on New York's offense, as he is relegated to more of a special teams role for the Jets.

injuries.name: Will McDonald IV
injuries.headline: Will McDonald IV (ankle) officially questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: McDonald will officially carry a questionable tag for Sunday's game after suffering a minor ankle injury during the week. It looks like he will be cleared to play in time, however, as HC Aaron Glenn told reporters that the veteran edge rusher should be available to play against the Packers.

injuries.name: Troy Franklin
injuries.headline: Troy Franklin (knee) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: Franklin found himself on the injury report earlier in the week due to a knee issue, but he was able to practice in full all week and will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Jaguars. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

injuries.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
injuries.headline: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) cleared to play Sunday
injuries.comment: Thomas suffered a shoulder injury during the team's season opener last week, but he was able to practice all week and won't miss any time because of it. He has been cleared to play on Sunday and should continue to contribute in his usual capacity for the Jaguars for the foreseeable future.

injuries.name: Cole Van Lanen
injuries.headline: Cole Van Lanen (knee) off injury report for Sunday
injuries.comment: Van Lanen's knee injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point and won't stop him from playing on Sunday. Jacksonville's offensive line should be at full strength in Week 2, which is good news ahead of a tough matchup against Denver's stout defensive front.

injuries.name: Foyesade Oluokun
injuries.headline: Foyesade Oluokun (wrist) will play Sunday
injuries.comment: Jacksonville has cleared Oluokun to play in their matchup against Denver on Sunday. That's good news for the team, as he is one of their key defenders and will be needed in what projects to be a close matchup in Week 2.

injuries.name: Jakobi Meyers
injuries.headline: Jakobi Meyers (wrist) good to go for Sunday
injuries.comment: Meyers was on the injury report all week due to a lingering wrist issue, but he is going to be good to go and will play in Sunday's game against the Broncos. Fantasy managers shouldn't trust in his week-to-week consistency at this point in the season, however, especially in what projects to be a tough matchup.

injuries.name: Aidan O'Connell
injuries.headline: Aidan O'Connell (personal) listed questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: O'Connell may not be able to play on Sunday due to a personal issue of some kind that he's managing right now. He is currently Las Vegas' QB3, however, so his absence wouldn't have a notable impact on their lineup.

injuries.name: Max Melton
injuries.headline: Max Melton (ankle) considered questionable for Sunday
injuries.comment: The Cardinals may be without a key defender on Sunday, as Melton is considered questionable to play due to his ankle injury. His absence would make life easier for Drew Lock, Jaxon Smith-Njigba, and Seattle's offense as a whole this week.
